# Card 3 — strategist, 2026-11-20 (saved by Jarvis; the agent cannot write files). Read every oracle text this round.

NO CHANGE defensible; if adding: Narset, Jeskai Waymaster in, Talisman of Creativity out.
- Narset: 3-mana Human body (009 thin start); "may" discard at end step, never forced. With Library of Leng, discards go on top; if spells cast ≥ hand size you redraw it all — each draw a Shabraz counter + life, each discard a Brallin counter + ping. A sequencing tool for the dump-then-end-step turn, not a standing engine (strategy:card-advantage.plan-draw). Without Leng or with hand > spells cast she is card disadvantage.
- Creativity: analyst shows W16/U25/R25 after the cut vs W16/U26/R26; white untouched; 7 rocks + 37 lands; cut rocks before lands; 1-damage ping a small cost.
- Rejected: Kindred Discovery (5 MV UU; Human is the right name — 14 Humans vs 4 Sharks — but ~14 triggers in 99 is thin and attacking with small Humans is the opposite of the plan; strategy:deckbuilding.curve, light). Cavalier of Gales best raw card (5/5 flyer, draw 3) but a fifth five-drop — runner-up for the same slot. Mirror Entity late-only. Knowledge Is Power flat anthem. Mishra's Command, Channeled Force, Demand Answers, Tolarian Winds, Locust God, Dack below Narset.
- Does not defend cutting Collective Defiance or Prismari Command: interaction thin, Force/Command not clean replacements.
- Expected dissent: Narset needs W+U+R on turn three with W at 11 sure lands, often stranded; no stack names her, argument only — NO CHANGE wins ties.
- Test: stack scenario, end-step Narset with Leng. `try` cannot see it (Leng invisible).
Open: companion has no section on end-step hand-reset engines; research-strategy topic: W thinnest colour and three-pip gold three-drops.

# Leng redirects; Mirror Entity layers — rules-question, 2026-11-20 (saved by Jarvis; the agent cannot write files)

PART 1 — Library of Leng redirects EFFECT discards, not COST discards.
- Narset, Jeskai Waymaster: NO. "You may discard your hand. If you do, draw…" — 118.12: the "[do something]" in "may… if you do" is a COST paid on resolution. Leng ruling: "You can't use the Library of Leng ability… when you discard a card as a cost, because costs aren't effects." Her hand goes to the graveyard; no redraw. Brallin still triggers per card (701.9a).
- Windfall: Leng applies (701.9b effect discard); redirected cards are still discarded (Leng ruling: "replaces the normal discard action with a discard action that puts the card on the library"). Agent marks the "greatest number discarded this way" count Not settled (no Windfall ruling); Jarvis: stacks 002/003 passed on "a redirected discard is still a discard", so they count.
- Kitsa: Leng applies ({T} is the only cost; "draw, then discard" is effect text).
- Collective Defiance discard mode: Leng applies; the redraw takes the top cards (121.1) in the order stacked — inference, not a ruling.
- Shark Typhoon cycling: Leng does NOT apply (702.29a; the discard is the cost, 118.1).
- Brallin triggers on every effect discard Leng redirects.
- DB note: discard is 701.9 in this CR, not 701.8.

PART 2 — Mirror Entity over Shabraz with ten counters: (X+10)/(X+10) (613.4b sets base, 613.4c counters apply after; Mirror Entity ruling). At X=0 Shabraz survives as 10/10. All creatures you controlled as it resolved are Human AND Shark this turn (613.1d layer 4; 205.3m), so Shabraz's Human flying grant and Brallin's Shark trample grant can target any of them — but only creatures present at resolution (611.2c); later entrants are not.

Asked: card three, or no change. Answer: Narset, Jeskai Waymaster in, Mask of Memory out; contested, and NO CHANGE is the fallback the pilot's rule permits, never a rock or an interaction cut. The branch audit reads every counted axis at target (interaction 8, exactly Walser's floor; card-advantage 27 against 10; colour sources blue 36 of 36, red 36 of 36, white 24 of 22), so nothing in the pool closes a measured gap and the swap has to earn its place as body-for-costume on the axis the log keeps naming: three losses opened with no board (003, 004, 009) and 005 blames small creatures that wanted resources, while the two combat-draw pieces already in the list only draw once Shabraz connects. The strategist's picks are rejected for the reason the orchestrator named: Collective Defiance and Prismari Command are two of the five targeted-removal cards, interaction sits at the floor and below the recon's consensus, and cutting either for a draw card puts the axis at 7; Prismari is also the heuristic's one artifact answer. Kindred Discovery's natural cut is a rock and the try screen reads blue and red one under target after a Talisman of Creativity cut; if it is ever added it is named Human (13 Humans in the 99 plus Brallin plus Imrahil's tokens, against four Sharks). Narset plus Library of Leng is real but is one card in 99 finding another; the case for Narset is the 3/4 Human body on three, with the refill as the rider, and the case against Mask is that Enduring Curiosity already does its job for every creature (Q046, decided).
